answer: Reaching the zenith of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the dawn until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the cipher of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit.
